name: Daffodil Bouquet
summary: The Daffodil Bouquet is a fresh bundle of bright flowers gathered by the herbalist Martie Jainrose in Lakeshire. Intended as a romantic token of appreciation from Guard Parker to Darcy, the gift inadvertently stokes local gossip and petty rivalry.

sections.title: A Tangled Token
sections.body: When Guard Parker wishes to express his gratitude to Darcy at the Lakeshire inn for packing his daily lunch, he arranges a gesture through the town's herbalist, Martie Jainrose. Martie prepares a bouquet of daffodils, noting they are her personal favorite. However, when delivered to Darcy, the bright blooms immediately raise suspicions: Darcy recognizes the selection as Martie's signature flower and suspects petty jealousy from the other woman, half-joking that Martie might have poisoned the stems out of spite.

faq.q: What is the Daffodil Bouquet used for?
aliases: what do i do with daffodil bouquet
faq.answer: The bouquet is meant for Darcy at the Lakeshire inn. Guard Parker arranges to have them delivered to her as a heartfelt thank-you for the lunch she prepares and sends to him on duty.

aliases: where did the flowers come from
faq.answer: Martie Jainrose, the local herbalist and flower vendor in Lakeshire, gathers and binds the bouquet upon request. She deliberately selects daffodils because they are her favorite bloom.

faq.q: Why does Darcy react suspiciously to the flowers?
faq.answer: Darcy immediately identifies the daffodils as Martie's favorite flower rather than a selection made specifically for her. Calling Martie a jealous rival, Darcy humorously wonders whether the bouquet was tainted out of spite, though she accepts the gesture nonetheless.
No. Darcy's suspicion is merely local drama and theatrical jealousy between the two Lakeshire women. The flowers are entirely harmless.

angles.text: Herbalists visiting Lakeshire will recognize the bouquet as the handiwork of fellow plant-gatherer Martie Jainrose, highlighting the domestic trade of wild floral gathering.
